settings.headline: Numbing cream for injections
settings.subhead: Numbing cream for injections is a topical preparation applied to clean skin beforehand to make the experience more comfortable — it reduces the sensation rather than removing it. Whether you need it depends on the injection, the area and your own sensitivity, and many practitioners apply their own numbing as standard, so it's always worth checking first.

settings.headline: Numbing cream and gel for injections
What to know
settings.body: Injections vary from quick and barely noticeable to sharper, depending on the area and the needle. A topical numbing preparation applied beforehand can take the edge off for those who find them uncomfortable. Numbing is preparation for comfort, not part of the procedure itself, and it's applied to clean, healthy skin before your appointment. Because many practitioners have their own approach — and often numb the skin themselves — the most useful first step is a quick word with yours about whether to prepare at home.

• Numbing cream for injections is applied to clean skin beforehand to reduce discomfort; it doesn't remove all sensation.
  • How much you feel depends on the injection, the area and your own sensitivity.
  • Many practitioners apply their own numbing as standard — check before preparing your own.
  • Senseless is a UK cosmetic numbing range, formulated in the United Kingdom — not a medicine.

settings.question: Can you use numbing cream before injections?
settings.answer: Often yes, as preparation for comfort — but many practitioners apply their own and have their own guidance, so always check with yours first.

settings.question: Does numbing cream work for injections?
settings.answer: It reduces the discomfort of the injection rather than removing it; how noticeable that is depends on the area and how it's applied.

settings.question: Which numbing format is best for injections?
settings.answer: A cream suits most areas; a gel suits smaller, precise spots. Your practitioner can advise what's appropriate.

settings.question: Is numbing cream safe to use before injections?
settings.answer: Used as directed on clean, healthy skin it's widely used for cosmetic treatments; patch test first and check with your practitioner, especially on sensitive areas.
